notes: Captured from the live EONET v3 API. events.recent.json is the response to status=all&days=30 trimmed from 877 to 159 events: all 16 tropical cyclones, all 29 IRWIN wildfires, every still-open and every multi-position GDACS wildfire plus every eighth closed one, the 10 flood events with the smallest polygons (the full response carries flood outlines of up to 120 KB each) and 6 of 11 icebergs. events.open-longlived.json is the response to status=open&category=volcanoes,seaLakeIce,severeStorms trimmed from 70 to 50 events (all volcanoes and storms, 15 of 35 icebergs). Events are unmodified; only whole events were dropped. The malformed variant was authored by hand from the same schema (it also contains a valid storm that crosses the antimeridian).
